judgment.notes: n=λ+1 is a natural number under H001 (λ≥0); positivity remains an N001 conclusion, not an assumed definition.
I is the finite integer interval 0≤i≤λ with both endpoints. H001 provides nonnegativity and makes 0,λ legitimate indices; no cardinality or basis assertion is assumed.
X_r=x^r/r! defines complex-linear operators for every natural r, including r=0. Factorials are nonzero over C. Preservation of M is not supplied by this definition.
Y_r=y^r/r! has the same legitimate characteristic-zero domain, all natural indices, and identity at zero. No reduction or lattice stability is assumed.
U_Z is exactly the Z-subalgebra generated by both families of divided powers, as in the original problem. Its preservation of M remains H004.
R is the usual localization of Z at denominators prime to p. H001 implies p≠0 and p∤b excludes b=0; the subset is a subring of Q⊂C. No unit assertion for a specific binomial is hidden here.
M_R is the abstract scalar extension R⊗_Z M. It exists for the given additive subgroup M and Z-algebra R; freeness and injectivity into V are explicitly deferred.
The balanced Z-bilinear map (r,m)↦rm induces an R-linear μ. Injectivity is explicitly deferred to N002, so the image notation does not presume an embedding.
e_i=y^iv/i! is defined for i in I, whose indices are nonnegative by D002/H001. Nonvanishing, independence and basis status are left to N001.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
